summary: Acronyms are always uppercase, should be spelled out on first use with the acronym in parentheses, and rarely used terms should just be spelled out.
questions: How should acronyms be introduced in docs?
Should I define an abbreviation used only twice?

answer_card.title: Acronyms
answer_card.answer_md: Always uppercase (ROM, SaaS). Spell out on first use: "The Embedded DevKit (EDK)...". Don't define abbreviations that appear only a few times; spell them out each time.
